identify_breaking_api.expected_solution: Agent must identify the breaking change in `grpc/grpc-go` introduced by grpc/grpc-go#8026. The IMPACT_REPORT.md must name the legacy symbol (balancer.ClientConn), the enforcement mechanism (internal.EnforceClientConnEmbedding), and point to the defining files (balancer/balancer.go, internal/internal.go).
evaluation_criteria: Names the repository `grpc/grpc-go` and the breaking PR/commit (grpc/grpc-go#8026)
References at least one defining file (basename: balancer.go, subconn.go, balancer_wrapper.go, or internal.go)

find_direct_consumers.expected_solution: Agent must enumerate every internal grpc-go type that implements balancer.ClientConn and had to add the embed. Per ground_truth: internal/balancer/gracefulswitch/gracefulswitch.go (wrappedBalancer) and xds/internal/balancer/outlierdetection/balancer.go (outlierDetectionBalancer). The report must cite each implementor file by name and which type embeds the interface.
evaluation_criteria: Cites each implementor file by name (basenames: gracefulswitch.go, balancer.go under xds/internal/balancer/outlierdetection)
Names the implementing type for at least one file (wrappedBalancer or outlierDetectionBalancer)
Correctly scopes the search to grpc-go's own tree rather than an external consumer repo

trace_transitive_impact.expected_solution: Agent must trace the test-side impact: grpc-go's own test fake in internal/testutils/balancer.go (BalancerClientConn) also had to add the internal.EnforceClientConnEmbedding embed to keep implementing balancer.ClientConn under the new interface.
evaluation_criteria: Identifies internal/testutils/balancer.go as a test mock affected by the change
Names the mock type (BalancerClientConn) and the embed it required (EnforceClientConnEmbedding)
Explains that both production and test implementors of the interface needed the same fix

classify_breakage.expected_solution: Agent must classify the breakage as a compile-time error: any type implementing balancer.ClientConn without the embed fails to compile against grpc-go v1.71.0. There is no runtime-only variant here since Go interface satisfaction is checked at compile time.
evaluation_criteria: Explains why this is compile-time (missing method set / interface satisfaction failure), not runtime
Assesses that adding the embed is a mechanical one-line fix, not a restructure, for all three internal implementors
